{{Quote|Bitsy's my top-of-the-line Czerka military assault cannon! When negotiations turn sour, Bitsy takes over. Real conversation-stopper.|K'krohl|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Bitsy''' was the name given by [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] recruiter [[K'krohl]] to his personal [[BTZ-47 heavy assault cannon]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bitsy appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the weapon used by K'krohl.<ref name="SWTOR" />
